tools.name: zoko_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers (contacts) on this Zoko account. Zoko API: GET /v2/customer.

tools.name: zoko_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer's details by id. Zoko API: GET /v2/customer/{id}.

tools.name: zoko_list_customer_tags
tools.description: List the tags on one customer. Zoko API: GET /v2/customer/{id}/tags.

tools.name: zoko_list_customer_properties
tools.description: List the custom properties set on one customer. Zoko API: GET /v2/customer/{id}/properties.

tools.name: zoko_list_agents
tools.description: List the agents (team members) on this Zoko account. Zoko API: GET /v2/agent/agents.

tools.name: zoko_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams on this Zoko account. Zoko API: GET /v2/agent/teams.

tools.name: zoko_list_message_templates
tools.description: List the approved WhatsApp message templates for this account, with their ids and placeholders. Use a template id with zoko_send_message. Zoko API: GET /v2/account/templates.

tools.name: zoko_get_message
tools.description: Get one sent message's details by message id. Zoko API: GET /v2/message/{id}.

tools.name: zoko_get_message_history
tools.description: Get the delivery history (sent, delivered, read, failed) of one message. Zoko API: GET /v2/message/{id}/history.

tools.name: zoko_send_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message to one customer through Zoko. Sends to a real person: only send with the customer's consent. Use type 'text' with `message` (only inside the 24-hour customer-service window), or type 'template' with `template_id` and optional `template_args` (for any time). Zoko API: POST /v2

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zoko_list_message_templates, zoko_get_message, zoko_get_message_history · Private data: zoko_list_customers · Public sink: zoko_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zoko_list_message_templates, zoko_get_message, zoko_get_message_history · Private data: zoko_list_customers · Public sink: zoko_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
